title: Solterra
description: Subaru Solterra from Home Assistant (toyota_connected) via InfluxDB bucket homeassistant. Location is not recorded.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "%" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_level" and r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mi" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_ev_range_ac_off" and r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mi" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_odometer" and r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mi" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_distance_to_next_service" and r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "%" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_level" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Range at 100% (normalised)
panels.description: Range (AC off) / charge % x 100, hourly, only when charge >= 20%. A slow decline over months is battery degradation; seasonal swings are temperature.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" and
      ((r._measurement == "mi" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_ev_range_ac_off") or
       (r._measurement == "%" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_level")))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["entity_id"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["2026_solterra_touring_xt_ev_range_ac_off"] and exists r["2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_level"] and r["2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_level"] >= 20.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r["2026_solterra_touring_xt_ev_range_ac_off"] / r["2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_level"] * 100.0}))

panels.title: Charging sessions
panels.description: Battery charging and plug state as the car reports them (1 = on).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "binary_sensor.2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_charging" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_charging" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "charging")

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "binary_sensor.2026_solterra_touring_xt_charge_plug_connected" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_charge_plug_connected" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "plugged in")

panels.title: Charge added per day
panels.description: Sum of state-of-charge increases per day. The integration's charging power is an estimate when the car reports none, so energy is shown as % of battery.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "%" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_battery_level" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Tire pressures
panels.description: This car's cloud currently reports no tire pressures (feature tirePressure 0), so this stays empty unless that changes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "psi" and r.entity_id =~ /^2026_solterra_touring_xt_.*_tire_pressure$/ and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "entity_id"])

from(bucket: "homeassistant")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mi" and r.entity_id == "2026_solterra_touring_xt_odometer" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
